blocks.x: Who was your favorite of all the tromboners when you were young that you liked to listen to?

Well, I'll tell you, I used to love the old man Big Jasper. He was nice on trombone. Smooth, I played. But there was a further noise there. It was all the light, you see. So you'd get a kink out of them and see they could raise so much playing on that trombone. They'd give you a good time. You were a reading fellow, a good time. Yeah. Especially out in the street and everything I think I thought, but they had no stuff like you. I used to love the old man Jack Carey. He didn't know. Watch, I forgot.
I was going to ask about Jack Carey. How was he? He was a real good, uh-oh.
He wasn't a good reader. He was a spart. Not a good reader, no? Oh, but a kiss.
See, them kind of guys that went on his way out.

Catch it that quick, huh? Anything. And then he got asked, you know, he got to go. He got to go. He got to go. Anything. And then he got to add to it, you know. Yeah. Add and take away from it. Ordered it like that. Prydips like that. Fully-carnished it like that. Some kind of guy.
